services.desc: Adventure VR is the first Virtual Reality Adventure in Hawaii. You will be immersed in virtual worlds for one hour, using the latest technology in VR. You will live, feel and experience adventures in 3D worlds. With your team, your mission will be to complete missions in these worlds. A fun, safe and memorable

blurb: Guests play collaborative virtual reality games in separate curtained areas, experiencing four different virtual worlds and completing missions together. Each game lasts about one hour and supports up to 4 players per game. The experience is designed to avoid motion sickness and is suitable for ages 8 and up.
